WITH busc AS
(
SELECT
BDG.FORACID AS CustomerAccountId,
BDT.TRAN_DATE_BAL
FROM  BUSC.LNS_EODACCTBAL BDT 
LEFT JOIN  BUSC.LNS_GENERALACCTMAST BDG ON BDG.ACID = BDT.ACID --AND BDG.ISLATEST = '1'
WHERE BDG.FORACID IS NOT NULL --AND BDT.ISLATEST = '1' 
AND CONVERT(CHAR(8),EOD_DATE,112)  <= 20230110 AND CONVERT(CHAR(8),END_EOD_DATE,112)  >= 20230110

)
,exclude_FORACID AS (
SELECT FORACID FROM 
    (SELECT FORACID, COUNT(*) AS CNT 
    FROM (SELECT FORACID, ACID FROM busc.LNS_GENERALACCTMAST WHERE DEL_FLG != 'Y' GROUP BY FORACID, ACID) A
    GROUP BY FORACID HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) B
)
SELECT 
    SUM(TRAN_DATE_BAL)
    FROM busc 
    WHERE CustomerAccountId NOT IN (SELECT * FROM exclude_FORACID)

WITH bnkm AS (
SELECT CustomerAccountId, 2023-01-10 PeriodDate , BalanceAmount FROM bnkm.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance 
    WHERE PeriodBalanceTypeId = 'EOD Running Balance of Transaction Date' 
    AND CONVERT(CHAR(8),PeriodStartDate,112)  <= 20230110 AND CONVERT(CHAR(8),PeriodEndDate,112)  >= 20230110 AND SourceSystemCode = 'LNS'
    --AND CustomerAccountId IN (
    --    SELECT FORACID FROM busc.LNS_GENERALACCTMAST WHERE isLatest = 1
    --)
)
,exclude_FORACID AS (
SELECT FORACID FROM 
    (SELECT FORACID, COUNT(*) AS CNT 
    FROM (SELECT FORACID, ACID FROM busc.LNS_GENERALACCTMAST WHERE DEL_FLG != 'Y' GROUP BY FORACID, ACID) A
    GROUP BY FORACID HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) B
)
SELECT 
    SUM(BalanceAmount)
    FROM bnkm
    WHERE CustomerAccountId NOT IN (SELECT * FROM exclude_FORACID)



WITH busc AS
(
SELECT
BDG.FORACID AS CustomerAccountId,
EOD_DATE,
END_EOD_DATE,
BDT.TRAN_DATE_BAL
FROM  BUSC.LNS_EODACCTBAL BDT 
LEFT JOIN  BUSC.LNS_GENERALACCTMAST BDG ON BDG.ACID = BDT.ACID AND BDG.ISLATEST = '1'
WHERE BDG.FORACID IS NOT NULL --AND BDT.ISLATEST = '1' 
AND CONVERT(CHAR(8),EOD_DATE,112)  <= 20230110 AND CONVERT(CHAR(8),END_EOD_DATE,112)  >= 20230110
and BDG.FORACID = '8b147f26a53740a32f7c87707c1ee0ff'
)

, bnkm AS (
SELECT CustomerAccountId, PeriodstartDate ,PeriodendDate, BalanceAmount FROM bnkm.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance 
    WHERE PeriodBalanceTypeId = 'EOD Running Balance of Transaction Date' AND CONVERT(CHAR(8),PeriodStartDate,112)  <= 20230110 AND CONVERT(CHAR(8),PeriodEndDate,112)  >= 20230110  
    and SourceSystemCode = 'LNS' 
    and CustomerAccountId = '8b147f26a53740a32f7c87707c1ee0ff'
    AND CustomerAccountId IN (
        SELECT FORACID FROM busc.LNS_GENERALACCTMAST WHERE isLatest = 1
    )
)
SELECT 
    a.CustomerAccountId, sum(BalanceAmount) bnkm, b.CustomerAccountId, sum(TRAN_DATE_BAL) as busc
    FROM bnkm a
    join busc b on a.CustomerAccountId = b.CustomerAccountId and a.PeriodstartDate = b.EOD_DATE 
    group by  a.CustomerAccountId, b.CustomerAccountId order by 2
